payload.text: CAPABILITY (equity cross-asset leaf): celnet-equity-vanilla::price is the generalized-BSM equity vanilla pricing entry on the carry seam — a pure, side-effect-free closed form taking (OptionType, &EquityInputs) where the dividend yield enters as the carry b = r - q, so the no-dividend limit collapses to standard Black-Scholes (proven by no_dividend_limit_is_standard_bsm) and the leaf reconciles to an independent QuantLib-pinned BSM oracle. Heavily re-used (in_degree 147) as the equity capability's projection target through the one contract. No I/O, allocation, logging, or mutation.
